brief:
A United Nations assessment found that 1.43 million Palestinians in Gaza are currently living in tents, Shehab Wire reported. The figures reflect the scale of displacement resulting from the ongoing conflict and blockade of the territory.

The UN mapping also documented that 82 percent of infrastructure in Gaza has been damaged or destroyed. The assessment reflects conditions amid what Palestinian officials describe as a war of genocide and a comprehensive siege.
dek: A United Nations assessment found that 1.43 million Palestinians in Gaza are currently living in tents, Shehab Wire reported.
title: UN report finds 1.43 million Palestinians living in tents across Gaza
